title: (Important) How to get the most out of this course!

cues.en: I made this course for you.
cues.zh: 我為你製作了這門課。

cues.en: I want you to do well.
cues.zh: 我希望你學得好，

cues.en: I want you to succeed.
cues.zh: 希望你成功，

cues.en: And I want you to get the most out of this course that you possibly can.
cues.zh: 也希望你能盡可能從這門課獲得最大的收穫。

cues.en: And so in this video I'm going to give you a few tips for how you can proceed through this course to maximize your learning experience.
cues.zh: 所以這段影片會給你幾個建議，說明如何進行這門課，讓學習效果最好。

cues.en: So here are five main points.
cues.zh: 主要有五個重點。

cues.en: And now I'm going to spend about a minute talking about each of these points.
cues.zh: 接下來每個重點，我會各花大約一分鐘說明。

cues.en: First of all it's important to make sure you understand what this course is all about.
cues.zh: 首先，要確定自己了解這門課的主旨。

cues.en: This course is about implementing math expressions and equations and concepts in Python.
cues.zh: 這門課是要在 Python 裡實作數學運算式、方程式和概念。

cues.en: It's not a course about a lot of theoretical or abstract math.
cues.zh: 它不是大量講解理論或抽象數學的課。

cues.en: Now, I do explain all the concepts in the slides before switching to code but I spend more time working
cues.zh: 在切換到程式碼前，我會用投影片解釋所有概念，不過我花在，

cues.en: on implementing math concepts in code than I do working through lots of examples and intricate details.
cues.zh: 用程式碼實作數學概念的時間，比講解大量範例與繁複細節還多。

cues.en: So the idea of this course is for you to learn how to use python as a tool to help you learn the math.
cues.zh: 這門課的理念，是讓你學會把 Python 當成學習數學的工具。

cues.en: That means you are going to get the most out of this course if you treat this course as a supplement alongside another math course in high school or university
cues.zh: 因此，如果把它當作高中、大學另一門數學課，

cues.en: or an online course, something that goes into the theory and the abstract features of math.
cues.zh: 或線上數學課的輔助，搭配那些深入理論與抽象性質的課程，就能得到最大的收穫。

cues.en: The reason why python is such a powerful tool for learning mathematics is that python can deal with
cues.zh: Python 是強大的數學學習工具，因為它可以處理，

cues.en: all of the implementation details and that allows you to focus on the important concepts.
cues.zh: 所有實作細節，讓你專注於重要概念。

cues.en: It allows you to build intuition based on going through lots of examples, and importantly a lot of visualizations.
cues.zh: 你可以透過大量範例，尤其是大量視覺化，建立直覺。

cues.en: In the videos I spend a lot of time going through code and explaining code and encouraging you to write code based on exercises that I give.
cues.zh: 影片裡，我花很多時間講解程式碼，也會給你練習，鼓勵你自己寫。

cues.en: But math and programming are not spectator sports.
cues.zh: 但數學和程式設計都不是坐著看就能學會的。

cues.en: So if you just watch the videos without working in Python yourself, then that's still pretty good.
cues.zh: 所以，如果你只看影片，沒有自己操作 Python，這樣仍然不錯。

cues.en: You're definitely going to learn something.
cues.zh: 你一定還是會學到東西。

cues.en: But if you really want to deeply get involved in the learning, if you really want to master math, then
cues.zh: 但如果真想深入學習，真正掌握數學，

cues.en: it's a good idea to have the video open and have Python open at the same time, so you can code as you're watching the video.
cues.zh: 最好同時開著影片和 Python，一邊看影片、一邊寫程式。

cues.en: One of the amazing things about video based and online learning is that unlike in real life, you can
cues.zh: 影片和線上學習的一個優點，是不同於現場教學，你可以，

cues.en: pause the video whenever you want. So don't hesitate to pause the video when I'm in the middle of explaining something.
cues.zh: 隨時暫停。所以，即使我講到一半，也別猶豫，想暫停就暫停。

cues.en: You can see if you can code faster than me, you can see how I setup the code and then you can change the code as you like.
cues.zh: 你可以試試能不能比我寫得快，也可以看看我怎麼安排程式，再依照喜好修改。

cues.en: And relatedly -- and perhaps most importantly -- you should think of my code more as starting code to help you get started. After you see the code that I've written,
cues.zh: 還有一點，也許是最重要的：把我的程式碼視為協助你起步的範例。看過我寫的程式後，

cues.en: you can change the variables in the equations or the parameters or the colors of the plots and so on.
cues.zh: 你可以更改方程式裡的變數、參數、圖的顏色等等。

cues.en: As I already mentioned, the best way to learn is by doing.
cues.zh: 我剛才說過，最好的學習方式就是動手做。

cues.en: And that's why I have an exercise associated with every single video and also larger projects at the end of every section of the course.
cues.zh: 因此，每一段影片都有練習，每一章結尾也有規模較大的專案。

cues.en: I go through all of these solutions to the exercises but you should also definitely try your best to solve the exercises before you watch me solve them.
cues.zh: 我會講解所有練習的解答，但在看我解題前，你也一定要盡力先自己試試。

cues.en: It's important to keep in mind that there are many correct ways to code.
cues.zh: 要記住，正確的程式寫法有很多種。

cues.en: So if your solution looks a bit different from my solution then as long as the end result is accurate it's OK if you set up your code differently from how I set up my code.
cues.zh: 如果你的解答和我的不太一樣，只要最後結果正確，程式安排不同也沒關係。

cues.en: As I mentioned in the previous slide, you should consider the code that I presented to be kind of beginner code that helps inspire you helps you continue on your own.
cues.zh: 如同上一張投影片所說，把我提供的程式當作入門範例，幫助你獲得靈感，繼續自己探索，

cues.en: Changing the code, improving the code and therefore getting the most out of this course.
cues.zh: 修改、改善程式，進而從這門課獲得最大的收穫。

cues.en: Math and programming are not easy.
cues.zh: 數學和程式設計都不容易。

cues.en: Anyone who tells you that coding is easy and math is easy is probably just trying to trick you.
cues.zh: 誰跟你說寫程式很簡單、數學很簡單，大概只是在騙你。

cues.en: But the hard work leads to big rewards.
cues.zh: 但努力會帶來豐厚的回報。

cues.en: I really believe that you have to embrace the course and embrace the learning experience, which includes a little bit of frustration
cues.zh: 我真心認為，你必須投入這門課和學習過程，其中也包括偶爾，

cues.en: every now and then. And I really believe that if this course weren't challenging then it would get boring and it wouldn't be worth your time or your investment.
cues.zh: 遇到一些挫折。我也認為，如果這門課毫無挑戰，就會變得無聊，不值得你的時間與投資。

cues.en: And speaking of investments, your brain is the most valuable and precious resource that you have.
cues.zh: 說到投資，大腦是你最有價值、最珍貴的資源。

cues.en: So invest in yourself, invest in your brain, invest in your future. And you should already be happy and
cues.zh: 所以，投資自己、投資大腦、投資未來。你現在就應該為自己感到開心，

cues.en: proud of yourself that you are doing the right thing by learning math and learning coding.
cues.zh: 也為自己感到驕傲，因為學數學、學寫程式，是在做對的事。

cues.en: The final point is that you should take advantage of your lifetime access to this course. As long as human civilization continues to support electricity and the Internet,
cues.zh: 最後一點，是善用這門課的終身存取權。只要人類文明還有電力與網際網路，

cues.en: you will be able to access this course. So you don't need to rush through the course as quickly as you can.
cues.zh: 你就能存取這門課，所以不必急著用最快速度上完。

cues.en: You should feel free to come back and re-watch videos that you've already gone through and you can always come back to this course in the future.
cues.zh: 已經看過的影片，隨時可以回來重看，未來也能隨時再回到這門課。

cues.en: And in fact, that's a good idea because I periodically add new videos and maybe even entire new sections to this course.
cues.zh: 其實這是個好主意，因為我會不定期新增影片，甚至加入完整的新章節。

cues.en: So you should come back and check out what's new.
cues.zh: 所以，可以回來看看有什麼新內容。

cues.en: I designed this course to flow in a specific order that the course is presented in.
cues.zh: 我設計這門課時，安排了特定的進行順序。

cues.en: So I do recommend going through the course videos in order.
cues.zh: 所以，我建議依照順序觀看影片。

cues.en: However, that is really just my recommendation.
cues.zh: 不過，這只是我的建議。

cues.en: You should definitely feel free to skip around in the course and watch some later videos even if you haven't completed the earlier sections.
cues.zh: 你完全可以跳著看。即使前面章節還沒完成，也可以先看後面的影片。

cues.en: That's all I have to say to get the most out of this course.
cues.zh: 關於如何從這門課獲得最大收穫，我要說的就是這些。

cues.en: Good luck.
cues.zh: 祝你好運。

cues.en: Have fun and I look forward to seeing you in the rest of the course.
cues.zh: 學習愉快，期待在後面的課程裡見到你。
